question: The couple who won Padma Bhushan in 2009 for Bharatanatyam are __________.

options.text: K. V. Sampath Kumar and Vidushi K. S. Jayalakshmi
Vannadil Pudiyaveettil Dhananjayan and Shanta Dhananjayan

solution:
The correct answer is __**Vannadil Pudiyaveettil Dhananjayan and Shanta Dhananjayan**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vannadil Pudiyaveettil Dhananjayan and Shanta Dhananjayan **are the couple who won the Padma Bhushan in 2009 for Bharatanatyam:
 
• The **Dhananjayans are well-known Bharatanatyam dancers from Tamil Nadu, India.**
 
• They** received the Padma Bhushan award from President Pratibha Patil** at the Rashtrapati Bhavan in New Delhi on March 31, 2009.
 
• The couple was** recognized for their work in preserving, developing, and spreading the Kalakshetra tradition **of Bharatanatyam
 
 
• through their dance academy, Bharatakalanjali.
 
 
 
• The Dhananjayans have also received other awards and recognition for their contributions to the art form.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Mahaboob Subhani and Kaleeshabi Mahboob are renowned Kuchipudi dancers from Andhra Pradesh, India.
 
• K.V. Sampath Kumar and Vidushi K.S. Jayalakshmi are Carnatic musicians from Karnataka, India.
 
• Krishna Ella and Suchitra Ella are scientists and entrepreneurs who founded the biotechnology company Bharat Biotech.
